encoder.checkpoint_boundary: A new 32-input detector must be trained and authenticated; the packaged 21-input checkpoint is Track O only.

route_decision.official_role: bounded fallback or diversity augmentation after separate authorization and manifest freeze; never an implicit full-dataset download
rationale: The same collector and normalized record contract can be used for controlled benign and authorized positive traces.
Run/host/scenario boundaries are observable and permit deterministic leakage-resistant splits.
OpTC is approximately terabyte-scale and TC E3 requires high-burden Avro/CDM normalization, so neither is acquired by default.
A bounded official subset remains available if local positive coverage is insufficient and a human approves it.

stages.name: adapter_collector_validation
stages.role: round-trip and safety validation only; never detector performance

minimum_admission.round_trip: raw collector record -> canonical record -> graph -> x[*,32] and edge_index

stop_conditions: a trace is reused in any later formal evaluation

stages.name: benign_training_background
stages.role: negative/background training, validation, and calibration groups

minimum_collection_design.coverage_requirement: Every admitted run contains process, file, and socket records or records an explicit zero/unknown count; no silent omission.
minimum_collection_design.group_disjointness: A complete host/run/workload group is indivisible. Repeated workload recipes use fresh host/run IDs and are assigned as whole groups.

stages.label: benign_by_controlled_generation
stages.label_boundary: The benign label is manifest metadata and is not passed to the encoder.

stages.name: positive_adversary

minimum_collection_design.authorization: Written authorization, isolated infrastructure, safety review, cleanup plan, and retention approval are prerequisites.
minimum_collection_design.prohibition: No FA1B2de playbook/action, no copied formal action sequence, and no live host enforcement.

fallback_sources.role: bounded positive/background augmentation if the official subset gate passes
bounded positive/background augmentation if the official subset gate passes

stages.label_boundary: Emulation or official ground truth is retained in manifest/partition metadata only; action IDs, annotations, and outcome fields are excluded from live features.

formal_fa1b2de: never in R5 corpus; reserved held-out evaluation only

global_exclusions: any formal labels, outcomes, playbook identity, or action identity
packaged Sample tensors and _VULN/_LINE/_SAMPLE as Track-L inputs
post-hoc source or run selection based on formal results
any corpus acquired before the separate human acquisition decision

acquisition_state.next_gate: human acquisition decision packet followed by source-hash and split-manifest gates
